name: MAMBASSA
description: Mambassa is a lively Italian card game played on the coast of the Marche province. It is a four-card variant of Petrangola (also known as 31), where players aim to collect cards of high value in a single suit, with a maximum of 41 points. The game features a unique 'monte' (table cards) exchange mechanic and knocking system similar to Schwimmen.

content.text: Mambassa is a lively Italian card game played on the coast of the Marche province. It is a four-card variant of Petrangola (also known as 31), where players aim to collect cards of high value in a single suit, with a maximum of 41 points. The game features a unique 'monte' (table cards) exchange mechanic and knocking system similar to Schwimmen.
Played on the coast of the Italian province of Marche. The name 'Mambassa' is of uncertain origin but the game is essentially a four-card version of Petrangola.
3-8 players (optimal with 5-6). Each player starts with 4 tokens (vite/lives).
40-card Italian-suited Piacentine deck. Rank: Ace (11), King (10), Horse (10), Jack (10), 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 (face value). No 8s, 9s, or 10s.
40-card Italian Piacentine deck; tokens (four per player, one agreed value).
4 cards face down to each player. Dealer looks at next 4 cards and either places them face up as the 'monte' or takes them as a hand (which counts as a knock).
